title: CSS module not loading inside dynamic routes when importing into both loading and page

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

body:
### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information

```bash
Operating System:
      Platform: darwin
      Arch: arm64
      Version: Darwin Kernel Version 22.4.0: Mon Mar  6 21:00:41 PST 2023; root:xnu-8796.101.5~3/RELEASE_ARM64_T8103
    Binaries:
      Node: 18.15.0
      npm: 9.5.0
      Yarn: 4.0.0-rc.42
      pnpm: 8.5.1
    Relevant packages:
      next: 13.4.3-canary.1
      eslint-config-next: N/A
      react: 18.2.0
      react-dom: 18.2.0
      typescript: 4.9.5
```


### Which area(s) of Next.js are affected? (leave empty if unsure)

_No response_

### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/abepuentes/loading-css-module-bug

### To Reproduce

1. npx create-next-app@latest
2. Add a file structure for dynamic routes
3. Add a loading.tsx page
4. import the same css module to both page.tsx and loading.tsx
5. Deploy or build the project

Error was introduce with next@13.3.0, working as expected on next@13.2.4.

Live demo: https://loading-css-module-bug.vercel.app

### Describe the Bug

NextJS let you add a loading.tsx page to render while fetching, if we import the same css module to this loading.tsx file and into page.tsx file, the style is not apply until refresh.

The reason to import from the same css module into this two files is to have the same styling while the data is fetching.

Works fine on dev, this bug its visible once deployed to Vercel/Amplify-Hosting or after building while using yarn start/npm run start.

### Expected Behavior

Style should be applied to the page file after loading without need to refresh the page. Working as expected while development. Workaround so far its pretty easy, just import style from different css modules.

### Which browser are you using? (if relevant)

_No response_

### How are you deploying your application? (if relevant)

next start, Vercel, Amplify Hosting
